versions.content: Tcp socket closure during address release If TcpIp_Re- leaseIpAddrAssignment () is called for a LocalAddrId then Tcp socket connec- tions shall be closed in the same manner as defined in [SWS_TcpIp_00109] with the abort set to FALSE and in IETF RFC 793.
